conflict:2.hook: A hairline crack in the scorched stone was slowly spreading toward both walls.
conflict:2.line: 'These two formulas *conflict* — chanting both at once will turn healing into harm.'

demand:2.en: The sealed gate at the cliff's edge had not opened in a generation. When I pressed my hand to the stone, it spoke in a low hum that only I seemed to hear. It did not ask a question — it issued a clear *demand*: give one word you have never spoken aloud to anyone, surrender it completely, and the way would open.
demand:2.cnHint: 悬崖边的封印石门向我发出____，要我献出一个从未说出口的字。
demand:2.hook: Deep in my chest, one word began to rise without my asking.
demand:2.line: 'The gate will *demand* one unspoken word — think carefully before you give it.'

emotion:2.en: Master Qingwu stopped my recitation at the seventh line. 'You speak the words correctly,' she said, 'but the formula hears *emotion* as well as sound. Right now yours is scattered — part fear, part pride, nothing whole.' She closed her eyes and waited. I breathed, found one clean feeling, and began again from the first syllable.
emotion:2.cnHint: 师尊说咒文能感受到弟子的____，让我找到一种纯粹的感情再重新开始。
emotion:2.hook: On my second attempt, the candle flame rose three times its normal height.
emotion:2.line: 'A formula reads your *emotion* as clearly as it reads your voice — steady both.'

consume:2.en: The old scroll warned that casting the word 'tempest' would *consume* a full day's worth of spiritual energy in a single breath. I read the warning three times, then folded the scroll and tucked it into my robe. Shen Wujiu had cast it twice before dawn. Outside, the clouds below our mountain began to spin.
consume:2.cnHint: 古卷轴警告说，施展'tempest'这个词会将一天的灵力____一空，而师兄黎明前已经施展了两次。
consume:2.hook: The spinning clouds below our peak had no natural cause.
consume:2.line: 'One casting will *consume* everything you have stored since winter.'

desire:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a single seed-word on the stone table between us. It glowed faint gold. She said nothing, only watched my face. I felt it clearly — a pull deep in my chest, a *desire* to reach out and swallow the word whole, to feel its power root itself in my breath. I kept my hands still. The gold light pulsed once, then dimmed.
desire:2.cnHint: 师尊将一个种子词放在石桌上，我感受到胸口深处有一种强烈的____，想要将它吞下。
desire:2.hook: The dimming light left a shape burned into the stone.
desire:2.line: 'Tell me honestly — do you *desire* the word, or do you desire what it can do?'

meal:2.en: After the morning lesson, Xiaoxing brought a wooden tray to the terrace: rice, two soft vegetables, a bowl of clear broth. 'A proper *meal* before a trial,' she said quietly, setting it down without looking at me. I noticed she had not brought a tray for herself. The broth was warm and tasted faintly of the herb-word 'calm.'
meal:2.cnHint: 小星在考验前为我送来了一顿____，但她自己却没有带托盘。
meal:2.hook: The herb-word 'calm' should not have been in the kitchen stores.
meal:2.line: 'Eat the whole *meal* — you will not get another chance before the trial begins.'

vegetable:2.en: The sect's herb-garden was not a garden at all. Each *vegetable* growing in the long clay pots was also a living word: touch the leaf of the narrow green one and your tongue shaped the sound for 'shield'; bite the root of the pale round one and your lungs filled with 'ascend.' I had been told to water them. I was afraid to brush a single leaf by mistake.
vegetable:2.cnHint: 宗门的草药园里，每一株____同时也是一个活着的词语，碰触它就会触发不同的法诀。
vegetable:2.hook: One pot at the far end held a plant no one had named for me.
vegetable:2.line: 'Every *vegetable* in this row encodes a word older than the sect itself.'

adopt:2.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a thin practice sheet and smoothed it flat on the railing. 'You must *adopt* a slower breath pattern when you write fire-words,' he said, demonstrating: long in, hold, short out. 'Master Qingwu taught me this in my first month. It is not natural at first. Your body will resist.' Below us the sea of clouds caught the last red light of dusk.
adopt:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，书写火焰词语时必须____一种更缓慢的呼吸方式，否则身体会抵抗。
adopt:2.hook: The red light below deepened to a color that had no name in any scroll.
adopt:2.line: '*Adopt* the slow breath now, before the characters grow too warm to hold.'

miss:2.en: A folded note appeared under my door before I woke. The handwriting was Xiaoxing's, small and careful: 'Do not *miss* the hour before sunrise — the gate at the northern edge will be open, and something is written on the stone inside that was not there yesterday.' I dressed in the dark and stepped out. The floating mountain was perfectly still and perfectly silent.
miss:2.cnHint: 小星留下一张便条，提醒我不要____黎明前的那段时间，北门的石头上出现了新的文字。
miss:2.hook: The silence on a cultivation mountain is never a good sign.
miss:2.line: 'If you *miss* the hour, the writing may be gone — it happened once before.'

yourself:2.en: Master Qingwu did not demonstrate the word 'endure.' She handed me the brush and stepped back. 'Write it *yourself*,' she said. 'I can show you the shape of every character in this sect's archive, but the word only becomes yours when your own breath drives the ink.' My hand shook slightly. The brush touched the paper and the air in the room grew heavy and still.
yourself:2.cnHint: 师尊让我____书写'endure'这个词，因为只有当自己的呼吸驱动墨水时，词语才真正属于你。
yourself:2.hook: The heavy air pressed down as if the word were already waking.
yourself:2.line: 'You must experience it *yourself* — no one else's breath can bind that word to you.'

century:2.en: The sealed room beneath the main hall had not been opened in over a *century*, Shen Wujiu told me, keeping his voice low. The lock was a word-lock: speak the right syllable and the stone door would recognize it. No one alive knew the syllable. He pressed his ear to the door for a moment, then straightened. 'It is speaking,' he said. 'Very softly. But it is speaking.'
century:2.cnHint: 主殿下方那间密室已经超过一个____没有开启，而师兄说他听到里面传出了声音。
century:2.hook: A locked door that speaks is waiting for something to answer it.
century:2.line: 'This door has held its secret for a *century* — and now it has decided to talk.'

management:2.en: In the archive hall, I unrolled a scroll older than the sect itself. It described the *management* of rare word-seeds — how to store them in jade jars, how to feed them morning mist, how to keep their meanings from fading. Shen Wujiu stood at the door, watching the clouds below the mountain darken.
management:2.cnHint: 我在典籍阁发现了一卷记载珍稀字种____方法的古老卷轴。
management:2.hook: The last line of the scroll was written in a hand that trembled.
management:2.line: 'The *management* of these seeds is a duty no one here has kept for thirty years.'

perfect:2.en: Xiaoxing handed me a smooth stone carved with a single word. She said it was the *perfect* vessel for carrying a healing formula through a storm — the stone would not crack, and the word inside would not scatter. I held it and felt a faint warmth, like a breath caught just before sleep.
perfect:2.cnHint: 小星把一块雕着疗愈字符的石头交给我，说它是穿越风暴的____容器。
perfect:2.hook: Then the warmth turned cold between my fingers.
perfect:2.line: 'This is the *perfect* vessel — do not let it leave your hand tonight.'

along:2.en: I walked *along* the narrow stone path that runs the edge of our mountain, reading the carved words set into the railing. Each word was a warning left by a disciple who had survived a heavenly trial. Near the end of the path, one stone was blank, freshly cut, still pale against the old grey rock.
along:2.cnHint: 我____山边小径行走，读着前人刻下的字符警示，却发现最后一块石头空白如新。
along:2.hook: No name, no date — only a single drop of dried ink.
along:2.line: 'Walk *along* this path every night before the trial — let the old words settle into you.'

harm:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a sealed jar on the table and told me the word inside could *harm* as easily as it could heal — the difference lay only in the breath used to release it. I nodded, but my hands were not steady. Outside, a low bell rang once across the cloud sea.
harm:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，瓶中的字符既能治愈也能____，区别只在于释放时的气息。
harm:2.hook: The bell was not the evening bell — it was too early, too low.
harm:2.line: 'Used without care, this word will *harm* the one who speaks it first.'

increasingly:2.en: As the trial approached, the words in my practice scrolls became *increasingly* hard to hold still. Letters shifted when I blinked; meanings slipped like wet stone underfoot. Shen Wujiu said this was normal — the mountain itself grows restless before a heavenly storm. I was not sure I believed him.
increasingly:2.cnHint: 随着天劫临近，练习卷轴上的字符变得____难以稳定，如湿石般滑移。
increasingly:2.hook: By evening, two characters had vanished from the scroll entirely.
increasingly:2.line: 'The words grow *increasingly* unstable — copy them into your memory before they fade.'

opinion:2.en: Shen Wujiu found a folded note tucked inside my practice jar — a record of a senior disciple's *opinion* on the trial I was about to face. The note said the hardest part was not the storm but the silence just before it, when every word you had learned seemed to forget itself. I read it three times.
opinion:2.cnHint: 师兄在我的练习罐中发现了一张纸条，记录着前辈对即将到来的天劫的____。
opinion:2.hook: The note was signed with only an ink seal, no name.
opinion:2.line: 'My *opinion* is that you should memorise this note and then burn it.'

previous:2.en: In the lower archive I found a thin book listing every disciple's result in *previous* heavenly trials. Most names had a small mark beside them — passed, or did not return. One name near the middle had no mark at all, as if the recorder had paused and then chosen to write nothing.
previous:2.cnHint: 我在下层典籍阁找到了一本记录____历届天劫结果的薄册，其中一个名字旁空无一字。
previous:2.hook: The blank space beside that name still smelled faintly of ink.
previous:2.line: 'Study the *previous* trials — the storm repeats its patterns if you know where to look.'

aim:2.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle in the air and told me that my *aim* in the trial was not to defeat the storm but to remain clear — to hold one word steady in my mind while everything around it dissolved. She closed her hand and the circle vanished. The cloud sea below the mountain flashed once with pale light.
aim:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，天劫中我的____不是战胜风暴，而是在一切消散时守住心中那一个字。
aim:2.hook: The pale light did not fade — it spread.
aim:2.line: 'Let your *aim* be one word, held still, no matter what the storm says to you.'

model:2.en: In the Archive Hall, I found a small stone *model* of the Cloud Sea Sect — every peak, every bridge, every gate carved with care. Master Qingwu had placed it here for new disciples to study. I traced each path with one finger, learning the mountain by touch before I ever climbed it.
model:2.cnHint: 我在藏档堂发现了云海宗的石制____，这是师尊为新弟子留下的。
model:2.hook: One peak on the model was missing — recently broken off.
model:2.line: 'This *model* shows every path — memorise it before you sleep.'

spot:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me along the outer bridge at dawn, pointing at the sea of clouds below. Suddenly he stopped. 'There,' he said quietly. I looked and managed to *spot* a faint silver glow drifting beneath the mist — a word-herb, rare and loose, not yet bound to any peak.
spot:2.cnHint: 师兄带我走在外桥上，我们____了一株在云雾中漂浮的珍稀字草。
spot:2.hook: Before either of us moved, the silver glow sank and vanished.
spot:2.line: 'Can you *spot* it through the mist? Look just below the third cloud layer.'

achievement:2.en: Master Qingwu pinned a small jade slip to the notice board outside the training hall. It listed each disciple's name and one *achievement* earned that month. Beside my name were two plain words: 'first breath.' It was the smallest entry on the board, yet my hands would not stop shaking with quiet pride.
achievement:2.cnHint: 师尊在布告栏上列出了每位弟子本月的____，我看到了自己的名字。
achievement:2.hook: Below every name, a second line had been added in red ink — all blank except one.
achievement:2.line: 'One *achievement*, however small, is how every great path begins.'

enter:2.en: A sealed door stood at the far end of the Herb Library. Xiaoxing told me that only a disciple who could speak the correct word-formula aloud might *enter*. I stood before it for a long time, lips moving in silence, rehearsing. Then I spoke — and the door opened without a sound.
enter:2.cnHint: 药草阁尽头有一扇封印之门，只有念出正确字诀的弟子才能____。
enter:2.hook: Inside, every shelf was bare — and a single candle still burned.
enter:2.line: 'To *enter* that room, your words must be spoken from the heart, not memory.'

eye:2.en: An old instruction scroll warned that a disciple's *eye* must be trained as carefully as the hand: to see a word-herb clearly is already half the work of gathering it. I had read the warning before, but only now, standing in fog so thick I could not see my own feet, did I truly understand it.
eye:2.cnHint: 一卷古老的教导卷轴说，弟子的____与手同样需要修炼。
eye:2.hook: When the fog shifted, something tall and still was standing right in front of me.
eye:2.line: 'Trust your *eye* before your hand — sight is the first step of every formula.'

shift:2.en: At midday the wind made a sudden *shift*, turning from west to north in a single breath. Every disciple on the training terrace felt it. Shen Wujiu looked up at once and said the wind only changes like that when the mountain itself is trying to speak — and we should listen.
shift:2.cnHint: 训练台上，风向突然发生了____，师兄说这是山在说话。
shift:2.hook: A low hum rose from the stone beneath our feet, then fell silent.
shift:2.line: 'That *shift* in the wind is not weather — something on the peak has woken.'

agree:2.en: Xiaoxing asked me to study the night-formula with her by the eastern lantern. I looked at my already-full scroll of notes, then at her hopeful face, and chose to *agree*. We sat together until the lantern oil ran low, and by the end I understood the formula in a way I had not managed alone.
agree:2.cnHint: 师妹邀我一起在东灯旁研读夜诀，我____了她的请求。
agree:2.hook: As we rolled up our scrolls, a shadow crossed the lantern flame from outside.
agree:2.line: 'Do you *agree* that the third line of the formula has been copied wrong in our scrolls?'

aware:2.en: I was copying a herb-chart in the quiet of the reading room when I became *aware* of a faint trembling in the floor — too steady to be wind, too slow to be footsteps. No one else seemed to notice. I pressed one palm flat against the stone and felt it again, patient and deep, like a second heartbeat.
aware:2.cnHint: 我在阅览室抄写药草图时，渐渐____到地板下有某种低沉的震动。
aware:2.hook: The trembling stopped the moment I lifted my hand from the stone.
aware:2.line: 'Be *aware* of what the mountain feels, not only what the eye can see.'

land:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an ancient scroll across the stone table. Its ink showed every floating peak of the Cloud Sea Sect, and far below them, a dark shape none of us had named. 'That shadow,' she said quietly, 'is the lost *land* our founders fled a thousand years ago.' The sea of clouds stirred as if it had heard her.
land:2.cnHint: 师尊展开古卷，指出云海深处那片被遗忘的____，云雾随之涌动。
land:2.hook: Below the clouds, something answered the scroll's glow.
land:2.line: 'That *land* below us has not forgotten the Sect.'

promote:2.en: Shen Wujiu placed a small jade slip on my palm. Inside it burned the word 'ascend.' 'Master Qingwu chose this formula to *promote* your spirit root to the second level,' he said, his voice low and careful. 'She does not give it lightly.' Outside, the wind through the pine trees fell suddenly and completely still.
promote:2.cnHint: 师兄转交师尊亲选的玉简，说此字诀能____我的灵根境界，话音刚落，松风骤止。
promote:2.hook: The silence after his words felt older than the mountain.
promote:2.line: 'This word will *promote* your spirit root — use it at dawn.'

purchase:2.en: At the Cloud Market ledge, Xiaoxing held up a dried silver leaf sealed in wax. 'Every senior disciple makes one *purchase* before the heavenly trial,' she told me, pressing it into my hands. 'This herb steadies the mind when the sky breaks open.' I turned it over and saw, scratched into the wax, a warning I could not yet read.
purchase:2.cnHint: 师妹在云市为我做了一次____，说此草药能在天劫时定心，但封蜡上刻着我看不懂的警示。
purchase:2.hook: The scratched words on the wax began, very slowly, to glow.
purchase:2.line: 'My one *purchase* here — and it may be the most important one.'

rely:2.en: I found the message tucked beneath my meditation mat: three words in Shen Wujiu's sharp hand — 'Do not *rely* on the wind formula alone tonight.' I read it twice. The wind formula was the only thing I had mastered. Above the peak, the sky had turned the deep, bruised color of an old wound.
rely:2.cnHint: 师兄留下字条，警告我今夜不可单独____风诀，而此刻山顶天色已如旧伤般深沉。
rely:2.hook: That bruised sky meant the trial would arrive before dawn.
rely:2.line: 'You cannot *rely* on one word when the heavens open.'

connect:2.en: Xiaoxing drew two circles on the stone floor with white chalk: one for my spirit root, one for the sect's main peak. 'The trial will try to cut every thread between them,' she said. 'Your task is to *connect* them again before the last cloud burns away.' She looked up, and her eyes held something between sorrow and steady faith.
connect:2.cnHint: 师妹在地上画出灵根与主峰的关系，说天劫会斩断它们之间的联系，我须重新将二者____。
connect:2.hook: Overhead, the first thread of light snapped like a cut string.
connect:2.line: 'Find a way to *connect* your root to the peak — quickly.'

indicate:2.en: The old stone pillar at the sect gate bore seven carvings. Master Qingwu traced the sixth with one finger. 'All records *indicate* that the trial begins when this mark turns cold,' she said, without looking away from it. I pressed my own hand to the stone. It was already cold. She said nothing. Neither did I.
indicate:2.cnHint: 石柱上的古刻____天劫将至的时机，师尊抚上第六道刻痕时，我发现它已冰凉。
indicate:2.hook: Master Qingwu withdrew her hand and closed her eyes.
indicate:2.line: 'These marks *indicate* the trial is closer than we thought.'

period:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread three open books on the table, each covering one *period* of the sect's history. 'Every great trial falls at the end of a period,' he said. 'We are at the end of the third.' He tapped the final page of the last book. It was blank — not unwritten, but erased, as though someone had chosen not to record what came next.
period:2.cnHint: 师兄以三卷史书说明，每段历史____的末尾都有天劫降临，第三卷最后一页却是空白。
period:2.hook: The blank page held the faint ghost of vanished words.
period:2.line: 'Every *period* of our sect has ended with a trial like this.'

picture:2.en: Inside the message tube I found a single folded paper. On it, Xiaoxing had made a small *picture* of our mountain in careful ink: the peak, the cloud gate, and one tiny figure standing at the edge. Below the figure she had written one word — 'ready.' I folded it back slowly, and when I looked up, the evening star had split in two.
picture:2.cnHint: 师妹在纸条上画了一幅____，图中山巅边缘立着一个小人，旁注'已准备好'，抬头时星辰已一分为二。
picture:2.hook: A star does not split unless the sky itself is cracking.
picture:2.line: 'I drew this *picture* so you would not forget what we are protecting.'

relate:2.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found a cracked jade slip. When I pressed my fingers to its cool surface, broken images rose in my mind. I tried to *relate* every detail to Master Qingwu, but certain memories slipped away like mist the moment I opened my mouth.
relate:2.cnHint: 我在藏经洞发现一枚破损玉简，试图将其中的景象____给师尊，却发现记忆不断消散。
relate:2.hook: One image refused to leave: a door sealed with my own name.
relate:2.line: 'I can only *relate* what I saw before the vision went dark.'

attitude:2.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the edge of the Observation Cliff, arms folded, back straight, his whole *attitude* that of someone carrying a weight no one else could see. I watched him in silence. Behind him, the sea of clouds churned in slow circles, and a single black feather drifted upward against the wind.
attitude:2.cnHint: 师兄站在悬崖边，他的整个____透露出一种难以言说的沉重。
attitude:2.hook: The feather rose higher than any feather should.
attitude:2.line: 'Your *attitude* toward the coming trial will decide everything.'

fill:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small amber vial into my hands near the Dew Stone Basin. 'Drink this,' she said softly. The warm liquid seemed to *fill* every hollow space inside my chest, steadying my breath. Outside the basin's ring of light, something large moved through the clouds below without making a sound.
fill:2.cnHint: 小星将药液递给我，那液体____了我胸中所有的空洞，让我平静下来。
fill:2.hook: Then the clouds parted, and the basin's reflection showed two moons.
fill:2.line: 'Let it *fill* the empty places before the trial begins.'

ignore:2.en: A pale inscription had appeared overnight on the door of my meditation chamber. Every elder who passed by chose to *ignore* it, eyes sliding away as though the words caused them pain. I copied the inscription onto cloth with a trembling brush. Master Qingwu, reading it, did not speak for a very long time.
ignore:2.cnHint: 我门上出现的神秘铭文被所有长老____，只有师尊看后久久沉默。
ignore:2.hook: At last she folded the cloth and placed it inside her own robe.
ignore:2.line: 'We cannot *ignore* what the door has written for you.'

necessary:2.en: Master Qingwu set three sealed spirit jars on the stone table before me. 'Take only what is *necessary*,' she said. Each jar hummed with a different colour of light — white, pale gold, and a deep red that pressed against its lid like something alive. I reached for the white one, then stopped.
necessary:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我只取____的东西，但那三只灵罐各自散发出令人不安的光芒。
necessary:2.hook: The red jar's hum grew louder the moment my hand moved away.
necessary:2.line: 'Take only what is *necessary* — the trial punishes greed.'

definitely:2.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled an old star chart across the worn floorboards of the map room. He traced a path with one finger and looked up at me. 'This route will *definitely* bring you past the Hollow Peak,' he said. Through the map room's single window, the peak in question was already wrapped in lightning.
definitely:2.cnHint: 师兄在地图室指出一条路线，说这条路____会经过空心峰，而那座山峰已被闪电笼罩。
definitely:2.hook: The lightning had no clouds above it to explain its presence.
definitely:2.line: 'This road will *definitely* lead you to what must be faced.'

forget:2.en: Near the Moss Bridge I found a small wooden tag hanging from a pine bough, my own handwriting on it. I had no memory of carving it. The tag read: do not *forget* the third bell. I counted the bells that had rung since dawn. There had only been two.
forget:2.cnHint: 我在苔桥附近发现一块刻有自己笔迹的木牌，提醒自己不要____第三声钟，但我完全不记得刻过它。
forget:2.hook: Somewhere below the clouds, a third bell began to toll.
forget:2.line: 'Whatever happens, do not *forget* the sound of the third bell.'

particularly:2.en: The spirit compass Xiaoxing lent me behaved strangely all morning, spinning without reason. It was *particularly* restless when I carried it past the old willow at the sect's northern wall. I knelt and pressed my ear to the willow's bark. Inside, something was counting — slowly, steadily, in a voice not quite human.
particularly:2.cnHint: 小星借给我的灵罗盘整个上午都在乱转，尤其在经过北墙老柳时____不安分。
particularly:2.hook: It stopped counting at the exact number of days until the heavenly trial.
particularly:2.line: 'It is *particularly* active near the willow — that matters.'

return:2.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found an old scroll wedged behind a cracked stone shelf. It recorded the *return* of a lost disciple who had crossed the Cloud Boundary alone and come back changed — quieter, hollow-eyed, carrying herbs no one could name.
return:2.cnHint: 我在藏经洞深处发现一卷旧册，记载着某位弟子____后的异状。
return:2.hook: The scroll's final line had been torn away by careful hands.
return:2.line: Master Qingwu said, 'His *return* brought more questions than the journey ever answered.'

remove:2.en: Shen Wujiu knelt by the sect's offering stone and pressed his palm flat against a dark stain spreading across its surface. He told me the elders had tried everything to *remove* it, yet each morning the stain returned, wider and colder than before.
remove:2.cnHint: 师兄发现献石上的污渍无论如何都无法____。
remove:2.hook: Beneath my fingers the stone hummed, low and warning.
remove:2.line: Shen Wujiu said, 'We cannot *remove* what has already taken root.'

colleague:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a letter at the pavilion table, her face still. It was written by a *colleague* from the sister sect on the eastern peak, warning that three of their disciples had entered the Mist Trial and never spoken again — not dead, simply silent.
colleague:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊收到东峰一位____的来信，信中藏着令人不安的警示。
colleague:2.hook: The letter's ink smelled faintly of ash and crushed moongrass.
colleague:2.line: Master Qingwu said, 'My *colleague* does not frighten easily, yet she is frightened now.'

normal:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me the sect's weather stone, a pale sphere that glowed soft gold each dawn. For seven days it had shown only grey. She said nothing about it at breakfast, trying to keep her voice *normal*, but her hands would not stop tracing the stone's cold surface.
normal:2.cnHint: 小星努力让自己的状态看起来____，却掩不住内心的不安。
normal:2.hook: On the eighth morning, the stone showed no colour at all.
normal:2.line: Xiaoxing whispered, 'I keep telling myself this is *normal*, but I no longer believe it.'

succeed:2.en: Inside the Hall of Names I read the carved list of disciples who had attempted the Heaven Trial in past ages. Fewer than one in ten had managed to *succeed*. The names of those who failed were not erased — they were marked with a single small cloud, drifting.
succeed:2.cnHint: 在名册堂里，我得知历代试图通过天劫的弟子很少能够____。
succeed:2.hook: My own name, freshly cut, waited at the bottom of the stone.
succeed:2.line: Shen Wujiu said quietly, 'To *succeed* here, you must first let go of the wish to survive.'

image:2.en: At the still pool behind the medicine garden, I looked down expecting my reflection. Instead the water showed a different *image* — a figure in white standing at the edge of a broken mountain, arms raised, clouds pouring upward from open palms like smoke from a quiet fire.
image:2.cnHint: 我在静水池中看到的____并不是自己的倒影。
image:2.hook: When I stepped back, the image stepped forward.
image:2.line: Master Qingwu said, 'That *image* is not a vision of the past — look again.'

ourselves:2.en: Shen Wujiu and I sat on the outer terrace as the cloud sea turned the colour of old bronze below us. He said that the trial ahead was not made by the sect or the sky — we had shaped it *ourselves*, word by word, herb by herb, choice by slow choice.
ourselves:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，即将到来的考验其实是我们____一手造就的。
ourselves:2.hook: A single crane flew past, carrying something red in its beak.
ourselves:2.line: Shen Wujiu said, 'We built this path *ourselves*; we must walk it the same way.'

catch:2.en: Running through the Spiral Corridor before dawn, I nearly missed a tiny jade slip that had fallen from a message rack and lay face-down on the stone floor. I managed to *catch* it before it slid over the ledge — and read a name on its surface that stopped my breath.
catch:2.cnHint: 我在廊道中险些错过一枚玉简，幸好及时____住了它。
catch:2.hook: The name on the slip was mine, written in someone else's hand.
catch:2.line: Xiaoxing gasped, 'You were just in time to *catch* it — one breath later and it would be gone.'

meanwhile:2.en: Master Qingwu handed me a sealed scroll at dawn and told me to guard it until the trial bell rang. I sat alone on the eastern ledge, watching the clouds shift below. *Meanwhile*, Shen Wujiu was somewhere on the western peak, learning the same formula from a different angle. Two paths, one truth — the sect always taught in pairs. Then the scroll grew warm in my hands.
meanwhile:2.cnHint: 师尊交给我一份密封的卷轴，让我守候；____，师兄在另一座山峰上学习同样的口诀。
meanwhile:2.hook: The warmth spread to my wrist, and the seal began to crack.
meanwhile:2.line: '*Meanwhile*, you must hold the scroll still — the formula feels every tremor.'

damage:2.en: Xiaoxing found the old herb shelf in the storage cave and called me over with a soft whistle. Several clay jars had fallen, and the dried word-leaves inside were crushed beyond use. '*Damage* like this,' she said quietly, pressing a broken leaf between her fingers, 'means someone was searching, not stumbling.' The dust on the floor showed no foot marks at all.
damage:2.cnHint: 小星发现储藏洞里的草药架上有____，那些碎裂的叶片似乎不是意外造成的。
damage:2.hook: Above the empty shelf, a single character had been scratched into the stone.
damage:2.line: 'The *damage* to these leaves was done with purpose, not haste.'

police:2.en: In the sect's archive room hung an old painted scroll showing the four Guardian Words — ancient characters said to *police* the boundary between the floating mountains and the void below. Master Qingwu had spoken of them only once, in a tone that allowed no questions. Today the scroll was facing the wall. No one admitted to turning it.
police:2.cnHint: 藏经室里挂着记载四个守护字的古卷，据说它们能____云海宗与虚空之间的边界。
police:2.hook: When I reached out to turn the scroll back, my fingers went cold.
police:2.line: 'Those four words *police* the edge of our world — never speak them carelessly.'

race:2.en: Shen Wujiu laid two glowing word-seeds on the stone table and said the test was simple: each seed would travel to the far lantern and back. The one that returned first would show which disciple had the cleaner breath-flow. I watched them *race* across the air in thin lines of light, neck and neck, until mine flickered once and fell still halfway. Shen Wujiu did not smile. That was almost worse.
race:2.cnHint: 我和师兄让两颗发光的字种____，以测试谁的气息更纯净，但我的字种中途熄灭了。
race:2.hook: Where my seed had stopped, a faint crack now split the stone floor.
race:2.line: 'Watch them *race* — the one that wavers first reveals the weaker will.'

medical:2.en: Deep in the sect library, Xiaoxing showed me a chapter she had found: a *medical* text written in the old style, where each cure was a spoken word held at a precise pitch. 'Healers here don't mix roots,' she said, running her finger along the faded lines. 'They shape sound.' I had grown up thinking healing meant bitter tea and rest. The page turned on its own.
medical:2.cnHint: 小星在图书馆里找到了一部古老的____典籍，书中记载用特定音调发音来治愈疾病的方法。
medical:2.hook: The character for 'breath' at the bottom of the page was still wet with fresh ink.
medical:2.line: 'This *medical* knowledge was lost for three generations — guard it well.'

wear:2.en: On the morning before the trial, Master Qingwu told me to *wear* the silver cord around my left wrist and not remove it until she said otherwise. It was thin enough to ignore, yet after an hour I felt it pulse faintly, like a second heartbeat slightly out of step with my own. Shen Wujiu glanced at it once but asked nothing. Some questions, I was learning, were themselves a test.
wear:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊让我____一根银色细绳在手腕上，它渐渐开始有了自己微弱的脉动。
wear:2.hook: By evening the cord had tightened one breath's width, all on its own.
wear:2.line: '*Wear* it close to the skin — it reads the words you have not yet spoken.'

climate:2.en: The archive keeper told me that the *climate* inside the Word Vault was kept cold on purpose: warmth made the older characters restless, and restless characters rewrote themselves. He said it with the calm voice of someone stating an obvious fact. I pulled my robe tighter and looked at the rows of sealed jars breathing faint silver mist. Outside, the season was turning.
climate:2.cnHint: 档案守护者告诉我，字库里特意保持寒冷的____，因为温暖会让古老的字符自行改写。
climate:2.hook: One jar at the far end was already fogged on the inside, though none of us had breathed near it.
climate:2.line: 'The *climate* in this vault is a promise we make to the oldest words.'

head:2.en: Shen Wujiu told me to bow my *head* and listen to the mountain itself before I tried to read the root-formula carved at its base. I thought he was speaking in metaphor. Then I knelt, pressed my ear to the cold stone, and heard — very faintly, like a voice recalling something — the formula already moving beneath the rock, older than the sect, older than the cloud sea. I had not moved when he came back an hour later.
head:2.cnHint: 师兄让我低下____，去倾听山体本身，我竟真的听到了比宗门更古老的口诀在岩石下流动。
head:2.hook: When I finally lifted my head, my shadow was pointing the wrong direction.
head:2.line: 'Bow your *head* to the stone before you claim to understand what is written on it.'

mistake:2.en: In the archive tower, I found an old scroll with my name on it. Someone had written a warning beside it: one *mistake* in copying the fire-word formula could reverse its meaning entirely, turning a healing herb into a poison. My hand had already moved. The ink was drying fast.
mistake:2.cnHint: 我在档案楼发现了一卷古籍，上面警告说抄录火字诀时一个____会让药草变成毒物。
mistake:2.hook: The ink dried — and the scroll began to smoke.
mistake:2.line: 'One *mistake* in that formula, and the mountain itself will reject you.'

staff:2.en: Master Qingwu gathered the full *staff* of Cloud Sea Sect at the Stone Altar before dawn. Every elder, every keeper of the word-gardens, every gate-warden stood still in the cold mist. She unrolled a pale ribbon and read from it without blinking. No one moved.
staff:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊在破晓前将云海宗所有____召集在石坛前，宣读了一道令人不安的卷轴。
staff:2.hook: When she finished reading, a single cloud rose straight up — against the wind.
staff:2.line: 'The full *staff* must hear this warning before the night passes.'

enhance:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a small jade tablet into my palm. 'Breathe the word on its surface,' he said. I did, and felt the characters shift. The tablet could *enhance* the power of any spoken word by drawing spiritual energy from the breath itself. I whispered one test syllable — and the air cracked.
enhance:2.cnHint: 师兄给了我一块玉牌，说它能____任何口诵字诀的威力，我只低语了一个音节，空气便应声炸裂。
enhance:2.hook: Far below, something in the cloud sea stirred at that single syllable.
enhance:2.line: 'This stone will *enhance* your words — use it only when the need is real.'

famous:2.en: Xiaoxing led me to a hidden garden where a single silver plant grew from bare stone. It was *famous* among disciples for appearing only once every sixty years, its leaves each carrying one complete healing word. She knelt beside it and listened, as if the plant was still speaking.
famous:2.cnHint: 师妹带我去看那株____的银草，据说每六十年才开放一次，叶片上藏有完整的治愈字诀。
famous:2.hook: As we knelt, the plant folded its leaves shut — all at once.
famous:2.line: 'This herb is *famous* for choosing its own reader — not every disciple may touch it.'

project:2.en: Master Qingwu assigned me a solo *project*: map every spiritual word carved into the East Cliff before the next dark moon. The carvings were old, some half-eaten by wind. I pressed paper against the stone and began. On the seventh sheet, a carving moved under my fingers.
project:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊交给我一项独自完成的____：在下次暗月前拓印东崖所有灵字，第七张拓纸下的刻文却动了起来。
project:2.hook: The moving carving left no mark on the paper — only on my skin.
project:2.line: 'Your *project* ends at the dark moon — what you find before then is yours to keep.'

record:2.en: In the inner hall I found a thin book: the *record* of every disciple who had attempted the Cloud Word Trial. Most names ended with a small red mark. Shen Wujiu's name was there, unmarked. Mine was already written on the last blank line, in ink that was not yet dry.
record:2.cnHint: 在内堂，我发现了一本记载云字试炼历代弟子的____，最后一行空白处已经写好了我的名字，墨迹未干。
record:2.hook: The book closed on its own — and the lock clicked from the inside.
record:2.line: 'The *record* never lies — every disciple who entered that hall is listed here.'

regular:2.en: Shen Wujiu told me the stone bridge between the two peaks held up only because of a *regular* offering of spoken words at dawn — one disciple each morning, one syllable at a time, feeding the bridge its spiritual balance. This morning, no one had come. The bridge was already humming.
regular:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，连接两峰的石桥需要每天清晨____诵字供养才能维持平衡，而今晨无人前来，桥身已开始震鸣。
regular:2.hook: The humming rose to a note I felt in my teeth, not my ears.
regular:2.line: 'A *regular* offering at dawn is all that keeps this bridge from folding into the clouds.'

security:2.en: At the outer gate, Xiaoxing showed me the word-seal that provided *security* for the whole mountain — a layered formula carved into the archway, renewed each season. She pressed her finger to one edge and frowned. A thin line of the carving had gone dark, like a lamp with no oil left.
security:2.cnHint: 师妹带我查看山门的封字阵法，这道为全山提供____的阵法有一道细纹已经暗掉，如同油尽的灯。
security:2.hook: Behind us, a wind came up from below the clouds — cold, and smelling of nothing at all.
security:2.line: 'Without this seal, the *security* of every disciple on this mountain rests on nothing but hope.'

whatever:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread the old scroll on the stone table and traced each line with one finger. 'Copy *whatever* words glow when the mountain shakes,' he said quietly. I pressed my brush to the page. Three words shone at once — far more than anyone had warned us to expect.
whatever:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，山体震动时，把____发光的字全部抄下来。
whatever:2.hook: The three glowing words had never appeared together in any known formula.
whatever:2.line: 'Copy *whatever* words glow, and do not stop your brush.'

predict:2.en: Xiaoxing found a thin jade slip tucked inside the old library door. The inscription read: 'No elder can *predict* the hour the trial begins — only the clouds will know.' She handed it to me without a word. Outside, the clouds were already rising faster than usual.
predict:2.cnHint: 一片玉简上写着，没有长老能____考验开始的时刻。
predict:2.hook: The clouds had begun to rise three days ahead of any record.
predict:2.line: 'No one can *predict* the hour — so we must be ready at all times.'

road:2.en: Master Qingwu led us to the eastern edge of the peak, where a narrow stone *road* wound downward through the mist. 'This path was sealed for forty years,' she said. A single fresh footprint marked the pale stone, pointing up toward us rather than down.
road:2.cnHint: 师尊带我们来到一条封闭了四十年的石____前，上面有新鲜的脚印。
road:2.hook: The footprint was still damp, as if left only moments before.
road:2.line: 'This *road* has been sealed since before any of you were born.'

solution:2.en: I had tried every cleansing herb in the storage hall, but the ink stain on the sacred cloth would not fade. Xiaoxing tilted her head and said, 'The *solution* is water drawn before sunrise — the mountain taught me that last week.' I reached for the morning jar. The cloth went still and cold beneath my hands.
solution:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，清除布上污迹的____是用日出前取来的山泉水。
solution:2.hook: The sacred cloth had gone cold in a way no water alone could explain.
solution:2.line: 'The *solution* is simple — water drawn before the sun rises.'

total:2.en: Shen Wujiu tallied the glowing stones in the archive room. He set each one down with care, then looked up. 'The *total* count is nine,' he said, 'but there should only ever be eight.' No one spoke. A faint hum rose from the ninth stone as if it were breathing.
total:2.cnHint: 师兄清点发光石头，发现____数量是九块，而本应只有八块。
total:2.hook: The ninth stone hummed softly, and none of us had placed it there.
total:2.line: 'The *total* is nine — one stone has no name in any record.'

fail:2.en: I pressed my palm to the sealing glyph three times, but the lock would not open. Xiaoxing watched in silence. 'If you *fail* a fourth time,' she said gently, 'the glyph may close the room for a full year.' I steadied my breath, studied each stroke of the character, and tried once more.
fail:2.cnHint: 小星提醒我，如果再____一次，这个封印符文可能会把房间锁闭整整一年。
fail:2.hook: The glyph flickered — and the door began to sink into the floor.
fail:2.line: 'If you *fail* again, this room will not open until next autumn.'

function:2.en: Master Qingwu set the carved bone tablet on the altar and stepped back. 'Its only *function* is to record the hour of the trial,' she said. I leaned close. Below the carved numbers, new lines were forming on their own, thin as spider silk, spelling words no one had carved there.
function:2.cnHint: 师尊说，这块骨刻石碑唯一的____是记录考验的时辰，但上面正自行浮现新的文字。
function:2.hook: The self-forming words spelled a warning no living elder had written.
function:2.line: 'The sole *function* of this tablet is to record — yet it writes on its own.'

method:2.en: Xiaoxing passed me a folded paper she had found pressed inside an old incense jar. On it was a single diagram and four lines of instruction. 'This is a lost *method* for reading cloud patterns before a storm,' she whispered. I unfolded it fully. The diagram matched exactly the shape of the clouds forming above us at that very moment.
method:2.cnHint: 小星发现了一张失传已久的纸，上面记载了读取风暴前云纹的____。
method:2.hook: The clouds overhead had already formed the diagram's final and most dangerous shape.
method:2.line: 'This lost *method* was hidden here for someone who would need it tonight.'

review:2.en: Master Qingwu set a sealed jade scroll on the stone table before me. 'Before the trial, make a full *review* of every word-herb you have gathered this season,' she said. I opened the scroll and found each word glowing faintly, as if alive. By the time I reached the last one, the candle had burned to nothing.
review:2.cnHint: 师尊要求我在试炼前对本季收集的所有词草进行____，翻完最后一页时，蜡烛已燃尽。
review:2.hook: At the scroll's final page, one word had vanished without a trace.
review:2.line: 'Make a full *review* before dawn, or the trial will find you empty-handed.'

ahead:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a rough map carved on bark. 'The Bridge of Hollow Wind is *ahead*, past the third cloud-ring,' he said quietly. I traced the path with one finger and felt the bark grow warm. A faint sound, like a bell struck once, rose from somewhere far below the mountain.
ahead:2.cnHint: 师兄给我一张树皮地图，告诉我穿越第三云环后，空风桥就在____。
ahead:2.hook: The bark map curled at the edges, as though something unseen had breathed on it.
ahead:2.line: 'Keep moving *ahead*; the cloud-ring closes before the second hour.'

cheap:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small clay vial into my palm. 'Do not think it *cheap* just because it looks plain,' she whispered. 'Master Qingwu ground three rare word-herbs into this formula.' I closed my fingers around it, and the vial pulsed once like a slow heartbeat against my skin.
cheap:2.cnHint: 小星把一瓶朴素的丹药交给我，叮嘱我别觉得它____，因为里面藏着三味珍稀词草。
cheap:2.hook: When I looked again, a single gold character had appeared on the vial's side.
cheap:2.line: 'Never call a gift *cheap* when a master's work is sealed inside it.'

critical:2.en: Shen Wujiu knelt beside the cracked spirit-stone and spoke without turning. 'This stone is *critical* to the sect's morning flight ritual — if it fails, the mountain will not rise at dawn.' I pressed my hand flat against the crack and felt cold air pushing through from beneath, slow and steady as a dying breath.
critical:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，那块裂开的灵石对宗门的晨飞仪式至____，一旦失效，山峰将无法在黎明升起。
critical:2.hook: The cold air from the crack suddenly stopped, and the silence felt worse.
critical:2.line: 'This moment is *critical*; one wrong word and the stone will shatter fully.'

motivate:2.en: Master Qingwu stood at the cliff's edge with her back to me. 'I did not give you the hardest formula to punish you,' she said. 'I gave it to *motivate* you to grow past what you think you can hold.' I looked down at the sea of clouds far below and, for the first time, did not feel afraid.
motivate:2.cnHint: 师尊解释说，她给我最难的符文，并非惩罚，而是要____我突破自己以为的极限。
motivate:2.hook: A single white feather drifted up from the clouds below, spinning slowly.
motivate:2.line: 'Let the difficulty *motivate* you, not stop you — that is the sect's oldest teaching.'

charge:2.en: Xiaoxing spread the duty list across the stone floor. 'Shen Wujiu is in *charge* of the east herb garden this week, and you are in charge of copying the storm formula before the trial.' I read my name twice to be sure. Outside, the sky above the floating mountain had turned a deep, unusual green.
charge:2.cnHint: 小星展开值务表，说明师兄负____东侧药圃，而我则要在试炼前抄完风暴符文。
charge:2.hook: My name on the list was written in ink that had not quite dried.
charge:2.line: 'You are in *charge* of the formula room tonight — let no one enter without the seal.'

complex:2.en: The storm formula Shen Wujiu unrolled was unlike anything I had seen. Its pattern was so *complex* that my eyes kept sliding off the edges, unable to hold the whole shape at once. He tapped the center glyph gently. 'Start here,' he said. 'The rest will follow.' Behind him, the sky had begun to turn.
complex:2.cnHint: 师兄展开的风暴符文图案极为____，我的目光不断从边缘滑落，难以把握整体结构。
complex:2.hook: The moment I touched the center glyph, all the other marks began to move.
complex:2.line: 'The pattern looks *complex*, but every part serves exactly one purpose — find it.'

itself:2.en: I found the message folded inside a split river-stone near the gate: no name, no seal, just the words 'The trial speaks for *itself*.' The paper was dry despite the morning mist. I turned the stone over and saw, pressed into the flat base, the faint outline of a hand far smaller than any disciple's.
itself:2.cnHint: 我在门边的裂石中发现一张字条，上面只写着'试炼自____证明一切'，石头底部还留有一个极小的手印。
itself:2.hook: The hand-print in the stone was still faintly warm to the touch.
itself:2.line: 'The word, once spoken, proves *itself* — no explanation will ever be needed.'

join:2.en: The ancient scroll listed every herb-word the Cloud Sea Sect had ever collected. At the bottom, a blank line waited — the space where a new disciple's first discovered word would *join* the record. Master Qingwu handed me a brush and said nothing. The blank line seemed to breathe.
join:2.cnHint: 门派的古老卷轴上有一处空行，等待新弟子将自己发现的第一个词____进去。
join:2.hook: The brush trembled, and the blank line began to glow on its own.
join:2.line: 'Your word must *join* this list before the storm arrives,' said Master Qingwu.

significant:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the archive shelf and pointed to a small jade tablet among hundreds. 'This one,' he said quietly. The tablet held a single word — older than the Sect itself. Even holding it felt *significant*, like touching the root of a very tall tree.
significant:2.cnHint: 师兄带我看一块古老的玉简，告诉我它____非凡，因为它比门派本身还要古老。
significant:2.hook: A crack split across the tablet the moment I set it down.
significant:2.line: 'Do not drop it — what you hold is *significant* beyond measure,' Shen Wujiu warned.

step:2.en: The library path was made of pale stone, and Master Qingwu told me each slab was carved with a forgotten word. I *stepped* slowly, reading the faint marks under my feet. By the time I reached the door, I had learned seven words no living disciple knew.
step:2.cnHint: 图书馆的每块石板上都刻有一个失传的词，我每____一步，脚下就有新的字浮现。
step:2.hook: The eighth slab had no word — only a question mark cut deep into the stone.
step:2.line: '*Step* carefully — each stone here holds a word that has not been spoken in centuries,' said Master Qingwu.

unique:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me her herb-word collection, then pointed to one glowing faintly blue. 'Every disciple has found this word in red or gold,' she said, 'but mine appeared blue.' Master Qingwu later told me a blue word was *unique* — it had never been recorded in any scroll.
unique:2.cnHint: 师妹的词发出蓝光，而所有卷轴中从未有记录，师尊说这是____的存在。
unique:2.hook: That night, my own newly written word shimmered — and turned blue.
unique:2.line: 'A blue herb-word is *unique*; guard it as you would guard your own life,' said Master Qingwu.

inside:2.en: The sealed chamber had no lock. Shen Wujiu said the door opened only to someone who already carried the right word *inside* their memory. I closed my eyes, recalled the first formula Master Qingwu had taught me, and the stone door slid open without a sound.
inside:2.cnHint: 这扇门没有锁，只有心中____藏有正确词语的人，才能将它打开。
inside:2.hook: Beyond the door, a single candle burned — though no one had lit it for a hundred years.
inside:2.line: 'The answer is not on the wall — it is *inside* you already,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

majority:2.en: I studied the mission board outside the training hall. The *majority* of tasks listed were herb-word searches on the lower peaks — safe work for new disciples. One task, near the top, was marked in red ink and had no taker. Its reward column was left blank.
majority:2.cnHint: 任务板上____的任务都是普通采词任务，唯独最上方那条用红墨水写就，至今无人认领。
majority:2.hook: As I turned away, the red-ink task fell from the board and landed at my feet.
majority:2.line: 'The *majority* of disciples never read the red tasks — and that is why those words stay lost,' said Master Qingwu.

notice:2.en: Xiaoxing had pinned a small *notice* to the door of the herb-word storage room. It read: one word is missing from the lower shelf — whoever finds it, return it before dawn. I checked the shelf and found not one gap but three, each outlined faintly in cold light.
notice:2.cnHint: 师妹在储藏室门上贴了一张____，说有一个词不见了，但我发现消失的词其实有三个。
notice:2.hook: The cold light around the third gap was slowly spreading toward the ceiling.
notice:2.line: 'Did no one else *notice* that the shelf has been touched since yesterday?' Xiaoxing asked, voice tight.

taste:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a written word on my tongue — an ancient healing formula recorded in edible ink on rice paper. The *taste* was bitter at first, then slowly warm, and the meaning of the word bloomed in my mind like a flower opening in fast motion.
taste:2.cnHint: 师尊将一个写在米纸上的词放入我口中，那____先苦后暖，词的含义随即在脑中绽放。
taste:2.hook: When I swallowed, the window cracked — a thin line, perfectly straight, top to bottom.
taste:2.line: 'Tell me the *taste*,' said Master Qingwu, 'and I will know whether the word has chosen you.'

differ:2.en: Shen Wujiu laid two jade scrolls on the stone table. 'Read them both,' he said. The first scroll glowed warm gold; the second pulsed cold silver. Their meanings *differed* in one word, yet that single word could mean healing or ruin. I copied both before the candle burned out.
differ:2.cnHint: 师兄让我对比两卷玉简，发现它们在关键词上____，令我不安。
differ:2.hook: Outside, the clouds shifted — the mountain had begun to descend.
differ:2.line: 'The two formulas *differ* by one word, and that one word changes everything.'

shape:2.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found an old jar sealed with wax. Inside lay a folded leaf pressed flat for a hundred years. When I held it to the light, its *shape* matched the mark on my wrist — a five-point spiral no one had explained. My hand began to tremble.
shape:2.cnHint: 我在藏书阁发现一片古叶，其____与我腕上的胎记一模一样。
shape:2.hook: The wax seal was still warm, as though someone had just closed the jar.
shape:2.line: 'The *shape* of that mark is not a birthmark — it is a seal.'

twice:2.en: Master Qingwu struck the bronze bell at the edge of the cliff. It rang once for morning lessons. Then she struck it again — she had never done that before. *Twice* meant danger, and every disciple on the mountain knew it. I grabbed my herb pouch and ran toward her hall.
twice:2.cnHint: 师尊破例敲了____铜钟，这是危险的信号，我立刻奔向她的殿堂。
twice:2.hook: A crack split the bell's surface before the second ring faded.
twice:2.line: 'She has only ever rung it *twice* — and the last time, three disciples never returned.'

aspect:2.en: Xiaoxing spread the old map across the floor and pointed at a blank corner. 'This *aspect* of the mountain is never drawn,' she whispered. 'No one who climbs that face comes back with words to speak.' The blank space seemed darker than the rest of the map, as if ink refused to settle there.
aspect:2.cnHint: 小星发现山图中有一个____从未被绘制，那片空白令人心寒。
aspect:2.hook: The candle flame bent toward that blank corner and would not straighten.
aspect:2.line: 'Every *aspect* of this mountain is mapped — except that one.'

currently:2.en: I found a note tucked inside my medicine box. It read: 'The outer gate is *currently* sealed by an old formula no one alive can break. Find the word hidden in the roots of the white cedar. Hurry.' There was no name at the bottom, only a small ink spiral, still wet.
currently:2.cnHint: 我在药箱里发现一张纸条，说外门____被古法封闭，要我尽快找到隐藏的词。
currently:2.hook: The ink spiral matched the one on my wrist, perfectly.
currently:2.line: 'The passage is *currently* sealed, but the seal is growing thin.'

decrease:2.en: Shen Wujiu traced a line on the frost-covered window. 'Watch the cloud layer,' he said quietly. Each morning this week the sea of clouds had sat lower. Its slow *decrease* meant the floating mountain was rising beyond the safe boundary — and beyond that boundary, the tribulation winds began.
decrease:2.cnHint: 师兄指出云海正在____，这意味着山峰已升入危险高度。
decrease:2.hook: By dawn, the cloud line had dropped below the red marker stone.
decrease:2.line: 'When the cloud layer *decreases* this fast, the sect has three days at most.'

possibility:2.en: I opened the old record book to find that only seven disciples had ever survived the night trial on Cold Tooth Ridge. Seven out of two hundred. Xiaoxing read over my shoulder and said nothing for a long time. Then she closed the book gently. The *possibility* of failure was a weight we now both carried.
possibility:2.cnHint: 古籍记录让我们意识到夜试的____，小星轻轻合上书，沉默不语。
possibility:2.hook: A single dried petal fell from between the pages onto the floor.
possibility:2.line: 'I will not pretend the *possibility* of failure does not exist — it does.'

crucial:2.en: The message arrived rolled inside a hollow reed, carried by a white bird with no markings. It named tomorrow's hour of gathering and added one line: 'The word you choose at the trial gate is *crucial* — speak the wrong one and the gate will remember you as an enemy.' I read it four times and burned the reed.
crucial:2.cnHint: 密信警告我，在试炼门前所选的词____，说错则门会将我视为敌人。
crucial:2.hook: The white bird was gone before I looked up, leaving no feather behind.
crucial:2.line: 'What you say at that gate is *crucial* — the mountain itself will judge your intent.'

enormous:2.en: Deep in the archive hall, I unrolled a scroll as tall as three men. The characters burned with old power, and the map it held showed an *enormous* cloud formation gathering above the highest peak — a shape no living disciple had ever recorded. My brush hand went cold.
enormous:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现一幅古卷，上面描绘着一片____的云阵正在最高峰上方聚集。
enormous:2.hook: The map was dated the night before the last great Heavenly Trial.
enormous:2.line: 'That *enormous* cloud is not weather — it is a warning,' said Master Qingwu.

pet:2.en: Xiaoxing kept a small jade-green sparrow that most disciples treated as a mere *pet*. That evening, the bird refused its seed, turned its head toward the northern ridge, and released a single clear note — the exact pitch used to signal an approaching trial. No one had taught it that call.
pet:2.cnHint: 小星养的那只小麻雀平日被大家当作____，却在傍晚突然鸣叫出预警之音。
pet:2.hook: The sparrow's eyes had turned the colour of storm clouds.
pet:2.line: 'It is no ordinary *pet*,' Shen Wujiu said, his voice low.

restaurant:2.en: The sect's gathering hall doubled as a *restaurant* on rest days, where disciples shared warm broth and traded minor formulas. Tonight every bowl sat untouched. A folded paper had appeared at each seat, bearing the same three words in red ink: 'The trial comes.' No one admitted placing them there.
restaurant:2.cnHint: 平日热闹的聚会厅也是门派的____，但今晚每个座位上都出现了一张神秘字条。
restaurant:2.hook: The red ink was still warm to the touch.
restaurant:2.line: 'Even in the *restaurant*, the omen found us,' Xiaoxing whispered.

driver:2.en: High above the clouds, a lone wind-skiff drifted toward our peak without a visible *driver*. The vessel's steering stone glowed a deep amber — the colour Master Qingwu once said only activates when a message of the highest urgency is set into the craft's core. The skiff landed itself in perfect silence.
driver:2.cnHint: 一艘无人驾驶的风舟飞来，没有____，却自行降落在山顶，带来了某种紧急讯息。
driver:2.hook: Inside the skiff lay a single sealed letter addressed to no one.
driver:2.line: 'A skiff with no *driver* carries only fate,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

dream:2.en: I woke before dawn from a *dream* in which the Cloud Sea parted and a pillar of silver light rose from the deep water below. Shen Wujiu was already standing at my door, pale. He had seen the same pillar — in waking, not in sleep — reflected in the bronze mirror of the inner hall.
dream:2.cnHint: 我从一个____中惊醒，却发现沈无咎在清醒时也目睹了同样的景象。
dream:2.hook: Two witnesses of one vision meant the sect's oldest warning had begun.
dream:2.line: 'My *dream* showed the same light yours did,' Shen Wujiu said.

consumer:2.en: Each spiritual herb in the medicine garden held a grade, and the trial ahead would be a fierce *consumer* of our highest-grade stock. Xiaoxing moved through the rows with a clay tablet, counting every remaining leaf. Her face grew tighter with each row. By the last bed, she stopped writing altogether.
consumer:2.cnHint: 即将到来的天劫是灵草储备的巨大____，小星在药园中清点存货时神色越来越凝重。
consumer:2.hook: The rarest herb — the one that could turn a trial — was already gone.
consumer:2.line: 'The trial will be a *consumer* of all we have saved,' Xiaoxing said.

interesting:2.en: Master Qingwu examined the message stone that had arrived at midnight and called its contents 'most *interesting*' — a word she never used lightly. The stone held a frequency pattern that matched no known sect or mountain range. Something from beyond the mapped clouds had sent us a signal, and it expected a reply.
interesting:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊检视那块深夜送到的讯息石，称其内容"____"，而那个频率来自地图之外的未知之处。
interesting:2.hook: Whatever sent the signal had been listening to us for years.
interesting:2.line: 'Most *interesting*,' Master Qingwu said, turning the stone slowly. 'Most interesting indeed.'

grade:2.en: The sealed box delivered to the hall contained three spirit-cores ranked at the highest *grade* our sect had ever received — enough to stabilise a torn meridian or endure a full Heavenly Trial. No sender's mark appeared on the box. Shen Wujiu read the attached slip and passed it to me without a word.
grade:2.cnHint: 大厅里出现一只密封箱，内含本派有史以来收到的最高____灵核，寄件人却不知是谁。
grade:2.hook: The slip read only: 'You will need these before dawn.'
grade:2.line: 'A *grade* this high is not a gift,' Shen Wujiu said. 'It is a debt.'

rule:2.en: Deep in the archive chamber, I found a jade tablet engraved with the founding *rule* of the Cloud Sea Sect: 'No word may be spoken for harm alone.' Master Qingwu had mentioned it once, but seeing it carved in stone made my breath catch. The tablet was cold — yet beneath my fingers, it pulsed once, like a living heart.
rule:2.cnHint: 我在典藏室发现了刻有云海宗立派____的玉简，触碰时它竟然跳动了一下。
rule:2.hook: The pulse came again, and the carved characters began to glow.
rule:2.line: 'The first *rule* of this sect is older than the mountain itself,' said Master Qingwu.

plant:2.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small clay pot. Inside grew a pale *plant* with leaves shaped like open palms — a Listening Herb, she said, used to translate the whispers of wind into words of power. I had never seen one alive before. As I leaned close, its leaves turned toward me, as if it already knew my name.
plant:2.cnHint: 小星将一株手掌形叶片的____递给我，据说它能将风语转化为力量之词。
plant:2.hook: Its leaves folded shut the moment a distant bell rang across the clouds.
plant:2.line: 'Care for this *plant* well — it hears everything you are afraid to say,' Xiaoxing told me.

national:2.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a worn map before me. It showed every floating mountain across the realm — a *national* record of all known Sects, their territories marked in fading ink. 'This was drawn before the last great storm,' he said quietly. One mountain near the eastern edge had been crossed out in red.
national:2.cnHint: 师兄展示了一份记录全境各宗势力范围的____地图，东侧有一座山被红色划去。
national:2.hook: The crossed-out mountain was the one we could see from our window.
national:2.line: 'This *national* record has not been updated in thirty years,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

doctor:2.en: In the healing hall, I met Elder Mossbeard — the only *doctor* on our mountain who could read medicinal words written in the old script. He pressed two fingers to my wrist and read my spiritual pulse the way others read a sentence. 'You carry an unspoken word,' he said. 'It is growing heavy.'
doctor:2.cnHint: 我在疗愈堂遇到了能读懂古文字脉象的____，他说我体内藏着一个未说出口的词，越来越沉重。
doctor:2.hook: He withdrew his hand and would not meet my eyes after that.
doctor:2.line: 'A *doctor* of words must first heal the silence inside,' Elder Mossbeard murmured.

economy:2.en: Master Qingwu set three candles before me and said that true power lay in *economy* — using the fewest words to move the most force. I tried to lift a stone with a long chant and failed. I tried with a single syllable and it rose. The candles did not flicker. But a crack split the floor beneath the stone.
economy:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊告诉我真正的力量在于____，用最少的词语撬动最大的力量，但石头升起时地板裂开了。
economy:2.hook: The crack spread slowly toward the edge of the mountain.
economy:2.line: '*Economy* of words is not silence — it is precision,' Master Qingwu said, eyes steady.

global:2.en: The old atlas in the east wing showed a *global* view of the cloud-sea world: every floating range, every dead zone where words lost their power, every storm corridor between them. I had thought our mountain was large. Seeing it as a single dot among hundreds made my chest tight with something between wonder and fear.
global:2.cnHint: 东翼的旧地图展现了云海世界的____全景，我们的山只是其中一个小点，令我又惊又惧。
global:2.hook: Someone had drawn a circle in fresh ink around our mountain's dot.
global:2.line: 'A *global* storm touched every mountain once,' Shen Wujiu said, 'and it is coming again.'

leader:2.en: Pinned to the door of the inner hall was a notice: the grand assembly would choose a new *leader* for the Cloud Sea Sect before the heavenly trial began. Candidates were listed in order of seniority. Master Qingwu's name was last — yet someone had drawn a small star beside it in pencil.
leader:2.cnHint: 内堂门上贴着告示，天劫前将选出新的云海宗____，清雾师尊的名字排在最后，但旁边有人用铅笔画了一颗小星。
leader:2.hook: The pencil mark was still fresh, and the ink smelled of high-altitude pine.
leader:2.line: 'A true *leader* speaks one word where others need a hundred,' Xiaoxing read aloud.

scientific:2.en: Shen Wujiu showed me his notebook — page after page of *scientific* records: the angle of dawn light that made certain words resonate, the temperature at which a healing phrase lost half its strength, the exact breath count before a flying formula would fail. It read like poetry measured with a ruler.
scientific:2.cnHint: 师兄向我展示了他对词语力量所做的____记录，精确得如同用尺子量出来的诗句。
scientific:2.hook: The last entry was dated yesterday, and it simply read: 'All formulas are weakening.'
scientific:2.line: 'A *scientific* mind and a poet's ear — you need both up here,' Shen Wujiu said with a calm smile.

evidence:2.en: The old stone table in the archive hall had not been touched in years — or so I thought. Dust lay thick on every surface except one corner, where a scroll had clearly rested until very recently. That bare patch was *evidence* that someone had come here before me tonight, searching for the same forbidden formula.
evidence:2.cnHint: 我在档案堂发现桌角无尘，这是有人抢先来过的____。
evidence:2.hook: A single muddy footprint led toward the forbidden inner door.
evidence:2.line: 'This bare dust is *evidence* that someone already found what we seek.'

prefer:2.en: Master Qingwu kept two kinds of spirit-ink — gold for healing words and silver for ones that cut wind. When she handed me a brush, I reached for the gold. She stopped my hand gently. 'Most disciples *prefer* the gold at first,' she said, 'but tonight the sect needs the other kind.'
prefer:2.cnHint: 师尊说大多数弟子一开始____金色灵墨，但今晚不同。
prefer:2.hook: Outside, the clouds below the mountain began to turn a deep, warning red.
prefer:2.line: 'Most disciples *prefer* the gold, but tonight silver is what we need.'

interview:2.en: I had expected a test of writing or memory. Instead, Master Qingwu sat across from me in the tea pavilion and began to *interview* me — not about formulas, but about the last dream I could remember. Each answer she wrote down in a small book, her brush never pausing.
interview:2.cnHint: 师尊在茶亭____我时，问的不是功法，而是我最近的梦境。
interview:2.hook: The last question she wrote down was one she never asked aloud.
interview:2.line: 'I must *interview* every new disciple before the heavenly trial begins.'

middle:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread the old map across the floor and pointed to a peak I had never noticed before — not at the edge of the Cloud Sea Sect's territory, not at the border, but exactly in the *middle*, where no path was marked. 'That is where the trial will open,' he said quietly.
middle:2.cnHint: 师兄指着地图正____的一座山峰，说天劫将在那里开启。
middle:2.hook: The peak on the map pulsed once with faint golden light, then went still.
middle:2.line: 'The gate always appears in the *middle*, never at the edges — remember that.'

standard:2.en: The sect's copy of the Sky Ledger listed every word a disciple must know before facing the heavenly trial. Xiaoxing traced the list with her finger and frowned. 'This is the old *standard*,' she said. 'Someone has quietly added three new words at the bottom, in different ink.'
standard:2.cnHint: 小星发现天劫前的考核____已被人悄悄篡改，多了三个陌生词。
standard:2.hook: The three added words, read together, formed a warning no teacher had ever given us.
standard:2.line: 'The old *standard* listed forty words — now there are forty-three.'

subject:2.en: Every lesson in the Cloud Sea Sect had a clear *subject* — wind control, root reading, sky-script. But the scroll left on my bed that morning had no title, no teacher's seal, only a single line of text that moved on the page like water, refusing to stay still long enough to be read.
subject:2.cnHint: 那卷没有____的神秘卷轴出现在我床上，字迹在纸上流动不止。
subject:2.hook: When I finally caught one word, it read: 'tonight.'
subject:2.line: 'A scroll with no *subject* and no seal — do not open it alone.'

accept:2.en: Shen Wujiu held out a small jade slip engraved with a defensive word-formula. His expression was calm but his eyes were serious. I hesitated — taking it meant I believed the trial would be dangerous enough to need it. At last I reached out and chose to *accept* the gift, and the jade warmed instantly in my palm.
accept:2.cnHint: 我犹豫后决定____师兄递来的护身玉简，玉片瞬间在掌心发热。
accept:2.hook: From somewhere below the clouds, a deep bell rang once — unscheduled, unexplained.
accept:2.line: 'Please *accept* this slip — I carved the word myself before dawn.'

act:2.en: The signal lantern on the peak flashed three times — the sign that the trial gates were opening ahead of time. Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve. 'We cannot wait for Master Qingwu,' she said. 'We have to *act* now, before the window closes and the cloud path vanishes for another year.'
act:2.cnHint: 小星说天劫之门提前开启，我们必须现在____，不能再等师尊。
act:2.hook: The cloud path beneath our feet began, slowly and silently, to dissolve.
act:2.line: 'We must *act* before the path disappears — there is no time left to wait.'

decline:2.en: In the archive cave beneath the north peak, I found an old ledger recording every disciple's word-power over decades. The numbers told a clear story: a steady *decline* in mastery had begun three years ago, each season lower than the last. I traced the column with my finger, cold spreading from the stone floor into my knees. Someone had drawn a small circle around the very year Master Qingwu fell silent.
decline:2.cnHint: 我在藏档洞中发现一本旧册，记录着弟子功力逐年____的数据。
decline:2.hook: The final entry was dated yesterday, and the ink was still wet.
decline:2.line: 'The *decline* started the same night the outer ward-stone cracked,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

extra:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small bundle into my hands outside the medicine hall, her voice barely above a whisper. Inside was a second copy of the purification scroll, the one Master Qingwu had said existed only once. 'I found this *extra* copy hidden beneath the floor tile,' she said. The scroll was warm, as if someone had held it recently, and a faint ink smell rose from its edge like smoke.
extra:2.cnHint: 小星在药堂外偷偷递给我一份____的净化卷轴，据说只有一份原本。
extra:2.hook: A shadow passed the window — too tall to be any disciple I knew.
extra:2.line: 'There should be no *extra* copy — yet here it is, and it is warm,' Xiaoxing whispered.

income:2.en: Deep in the sect's accounting room I unrolled a brittle record of spirit-crystal flow. The sect's *income* from traded healing words had dropped to almost nothing since the cloud-roads closed. I understood now why the outer hall was cold and the lamps were dim. A separate column, written in red, showed a private source of crystals still arriving — but the sender's name had been carefully cut away.
income:2.cnHint: 我在账房发现宗门的____已几乎断绝，却有一笔来源不明的私人供给。
income:2.hook: The cut edge of the paper was clean — done with a cultivator's precise blade.
income:2.line: 'Without *income* from the lower roads, we cannot keep the ward-fires burning,' Shen Wujiu said.

medicine:2.en: The supply room held rows of clay jars, each sealed with a word-glyph. I was sent to count them, but one shelf stopped me cold. Every jar labeled with the word for *medicine* had been opened and resealed — the original glyph pressed slightly crooked, the way a hurried hand leaves it. The contents smelled right, like pine smoke and river stone, yet one jar held only grey ash where living herbs should have been.
medicine:2.cnHint: 我在库房清点时，发现所有标注____的罐子都被人悄悄开封又重新封好。
medicine:2.hook: Ash does not grow on its own — someone had burned the herbs on purpose.
medicine:2.line: 'This *medicine* was replaced,' I said, my voice flat, holding the ash-jar toward the torchlight.

private:2.en: I carried a sealed letter from Xiaoxing to a small stone room at the mountain's eastern edge, a room I had never noticed before. A wooden plate by the door read: *private* study, no entry. The door swung open at my touch — unlocked, which it should not have been. Inside, a single candle burned low beside an open book, and the chair was still warm from whoever had just left it.
private:2.cnHint: 小星让我送一封信到东崖的____书房，到达时房门竟是虚掩着的。
private:2.hook: The open book showed a diagram of the sect's main ward — with three points circled in red.
private:2.line: 'This is Master Qingwu's *private* room — no one else should have a key,' Xiaoxing said.

side:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me along the narrow path that ran beside the great cloud-fall, then stopped and pointed to the cliff face on our left. Carved into the stone on that *side* of the mountain were names — dozens of them — each paired with a word-seal I did not recognise. Some names I knew from the old ledger. Near the bottom, fresh chisel marks still held white dust, and one name was only half-finished.
side:2.cnHint: 师兄带我去云瀑旁，在山崖____的石壁上，我们发现了密密麻麻的名字和印记。
side:2.hook: The unfinished name ended with the first character of my own.
side:2.line: 'Look at the *side* wall closely — those seals are not sect-standard,' Shen Wujiu said.

air:2.en: I opened the sealed chamber at Master Qingwu's request and stepped inside to retrieve a jade case. The moment the door moved, the *air* that rushed out was wrong — heavy with the smell of burnt ink and cold metal, like a word-formula had been held under pressure for too long. The jade case sat exactly where it should, undisturbed, but every paper on the surrounding shelf had been turned face-down.
air:2.cnHint: 我打开密室取玉匣，扑面而来的____中混着焦墨气息，架上的文书全部被翻面朝下。
air:2.hook: On the back of the nearest paper, in small characters, were two words: 'do not open.'
air:2.line: 'The *air* in there has not moved in months — or something kept it sealed,' Master Qingwu said.

consumption:2.en: The crystal-fire at the hall's centre should have burned for ten years on its current charge; the maintenance record said so. But a new reading hung beside it on a copper plate, and the numbers made my breath catch. The *consumption* rate had tripled in the past month, the crystal shrinking fast. At this pace the ward-fire would die before the next full moon, and every protection it held would go out with it.
consumption:2.cnHint: 大殿中央的晶火能量____速率在过去一月内突然翻了三倍，护法结界危在旦夕。
consumption:2.hook: Someone had taped the old reading back over the new one — hoping no one would look twice.
consumption:2.line: 'At this *consumption* rate, the ward-fire has three weeks at most,' Shen Wujiu said.

field:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the eastern terrace, a wide stone platform open to the sky. 'Every disciple trains in their own *field*,' he said, sweeping his arm across the empty space. 'Yours begins here.' The carved floor held a hundred silent word-slots, waiting to be filled. At the center, a single slot glowed faint amber.
field:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到东台，说每个弟子都有自己的修炼____，地板中央一个刻槽散发着微光。
field:2.hook: The amber light pulsed once, then went dark.
field:2.line: 'Every disciple works within a *field* — yours is smaller than you think.'

personality:2.en: Master Qingwu handed me a thin jade slip etched with my name. 'A word-formula reads your *personality* before it answers you,' she said quietly. 'Speak a word with fear and it will fear you back.' I pressed the slip to my palm. The characters warmed, then rearranged themselves into a shape I did not recognize.
personality:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊说，功法会感应修炼者的____再作回应，我手中的玉简上字迹悄然变换。
personality:2.hook: The new shape was not in any scroll I had ever read.
personality:2.line: 'A formula mirrors your *personality* — hide nothing from it.'

size:2.en: Xiaoxing unrolled a cloud-silk map on the study table. Every floating mountain was marked, each one labeled with its spiritual rank. 'The *size* of a mountain means nothing,' she said, tapping a tiny peak near the edge. 'This small one holds the oldest word-root in the sect.' The lamp above us flickered without wind.
size:2.cnHint: 小星展开云绸地图，说山峰的____并不重要，图边那座最小的山峰藏着宗门最古老的字根。
size:2.hook: The lamp's flame leaned toward that tiny peak and held.
size:2.line: 'Do not judge a word-root by the *size* of the mountain that holds it.'

schedule:2.en: I found a paper pinned to my door before dawn. It was a *schedule* written in Master Qingwu's narrow hand — seven hours of word-study, two of silence, one of open sky. At the bottom she had added a single line in red ink that was not part of any hour. I read it three times and still could not tell whether it was a warning or a promise.
schedule:2.cnHint: 我在门上发现了师尊亲手写的____，底部有一行红字不属于任何时段，像警告，又像承诺。
schedule:2.hook: The red ink smelled faintly of storm-cloud resin.
schedule:2.line: 'Follow the *schedule* exactly — the red line especially.'

towards:2.en: Shen Wujiu pointed *towards* the north peak, where a narrow bridge of cloud linked two cliffs. 'A word-scroll was left there last night,' he said, voice careful. 'No one knows who placed it.' I looked where he pointed. The bridge shivered, though the air was still, and a faint hum rose from the direction of the scroll.
towards:2.cnHint: 师兄指向北峰的云桥说，昨夜有人在那里留下了一卷功法，无人知晓是谁所放。
towards:2.hook: The hum carried one syllable, repeated.
towards:2.line: 'Walk *towards* the north peak and do not look down.'

background:2.en: The registration hall kept a stone ledger, one page per disciple. Xiaoxing showed me mine. Most entries listed family lineage and home mountain, but the column marked *background* for my page was blank — not empty by accident, but smoothed over, as if someone had pressed the words away. She closed the ledger without meeting my eyes.
background:2.cnHint: 弟子名册中每人都有____一栏，而我的那栏不是留白，而是被人刻意抹平了。
background:2.hook: The smoothed stone was still faintly warm.
background:2.line: 'A blank *background* in this ledger has only one meaning.'

department:2.en: Each word-art belongs to a *department* of the sect: Healing, Storm, or Flight. Master Qingwu told me I had one day to choose mine and enter my name in the correct hall. I walked all three corridors twice. When I reached the Storm hall the second time, the door opened on its own, though no hand had touched it.
department:2.cnHint: 宗门功法分为三个____：治愈、风暴与飞行，我需在一日内选定，但风暴殿的门无人触碰却自行开启。
department:2.hook: A single feather rested on the Storm hall floor, still trembling.
department:2.line: 'Every word-art belongs to a *department* — choose before sundown.'

detail:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread the old formula across the light-table so I could see every stroke. 'Study each *detail*,' he said, pressing a finger beside a tiny mark I had nearly missed. 'That curved line is not decoration — it decides whether the word heals or burns.' Outside, the clouds beneath the mountain began to glow a slow, deep red.
detail:2.cnHint: 师兄叫我仔细研究功法的每个____，指出一处细微弯笔能决定这个字是治愈还是灼伤。
detail:2.hook: The clouds below had never glowed red before nightfall.
detail:2.line: 'One wrong *detail* in a formula can change everything it touches.'

estimate:2.en: The old library at the heart of the mountain held ten thousand scrolls. I tried to *estimate* how many years it would take to read them all, but the number slipped away like mist. Shen Wujiu found me standing still among the shelves, neck bent back, staring at rows that seemed to have no end.
estimate:2.cnHint: 我试图____藏经阁中书卷的数量，却发现那数字大得无从把握。
estimate:2.hook: One scroll at the very top glowed faintly, and it had no title.
estimate:2.line: 'My *estimate* is ten lifetimes — and that is only the first floor,' said Shen Wujiu.

explore:2.en: Master Qingwu sent us into the Mist Corridor alone. 'Do not follow the marked path,' she said. 'You must *explore* the space between the words, not the words themselves.' Xiaoxing pressed her palm to the stone wall and a hidden door opened, breathing cold air onto our faces.
explore:2.cnHint: 师尊命我们____迷雾走廊中文字之间的空间，小星发现了一扇隐藏的门。
explore:2.hook: Beyond the door, someone had already lit a lamp.
explore:2.line: 'We should *explore* the left passage — the right one has no echo,' said Xiaoxing.

fix:2.en: I stood at the edge of the outer terrace, trying to *fix* the position of the distant peak in my mind. Shen Wujiu told me that a disciple who loses their sense of place will lose their words next. Below, the sea of clouds shifted, and for a moment the peak was gone entirely.
fix:2.cnHint: 我试图____远处山峰在心中的方位，以免迷失自己的文字。
fix:2.hook: When the clouds parted again, the peak had moved three degrees to the east.
fix:2.line: '*Fix* the peak in your mind before the clouds return,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

general:2.en: The first lesson was not about rare or powerful words. It was about *general* ones — the kind used every day, in markets, in fields, by ordinary people. Master Qingwu said that a disciple who ignores common words builds a house with no floor. I copied each one carefully onto pale bark paper.
general:2.cnHint: 师尊教导我们，____的日常文字才是修行的根基，不可忽视。
general:2.hook: The last word on the list was one I had never seen before.
general:2.line: 'The *general* words carry more power than you think,' Master Qingwu said.

loss:2.en: In the archive room, Xiaoxing discovered an empty case where a scroll had once rested. The label said only: Restoration Formula, recovered from the lower cloud — and nothing more. The *loss* was recorded in the sect ledger with a single brushstroke, as though one word could hold what was gone.
loss:2.cnHint: 小星在档案室发现一个空匣，记录册上用一笔记下了这份____。
loss:2.hook: The dust inside the case was still warm.
loss:2.line: 'The *loss* of that scroll concerns me more than the storm ahead,' said Master Qingwu.

partner:2.en: Each new disciple was paired with one senior. Shen Wujiu became my *partner* for the season of wind trials. He was quiet and careful, and when I stumbled on the syllable for 'balance,' he said nothing — he only stood close enough that I could not fall. I did not forget the word again.
partner:2.cnHint: 沈无咎成为我风试季节的____，他用无声的陪伴帮我记住了那个字。
partner:2.hook: That night, his practice lantern went out without wind.
partner:2.line: 'A good *partner* does not correct you — they stand beside you,' Shen Wujiu said.

concept:2.en: The hardest part was not memorizing words but understanding the *concept* behind each one. The word for 'lift' meant nothing until I felt the mountain push upward through my heels. Master Qingwu said the body must learn what the mind only thinks it knows. I closed my eyes and let the stone teach me.
concept:2.cnHint: 师尊说，每个字背后的____比字形本身更难掌握，需要身体去感受。
concept:2.hook: When I opened my eyes, I was one full step above the ground.
concept:2.line: 'The *concept* must live in your bones, not only your memory,' said Master Qingwu.

history:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me the oldest wall in the sect — carved with names and words going back three hundred years. 'This is our *history*,' she said softly. Some names had been worn away by weather; their words remained. I touched a character near the base and felt a faint warmth, like a hand just lifted away.
history:2.cnHint: 小星带我看刻满姓名与文字的古墙，那是云海宗三百年的____。
